title: Account
description: A target company. Derives from the rows of the commercial state file (`commercial_state_file`) and the contact queue file (`contact_queue_file`).

domain.description: Deduplication key and the per-account tracking value carried by `Message.utm_content`.

segment_id.description: The segment this account belongs to.
segment_id.$comment: Open string. Values are validated against the workspace's market configuration in `references/markets/`, which instantiates the `segment_definitions` slot. The reference motion used four ordered segments; the order is the work sequence.

lifecycle.description: Mirrors the lifecycle field of the configured CRM (`crm_system`). Distinct from `state`, which is the GTM state machine.

state.description: State in the GTM state machine.

score_breakdown.description: Six dimensions with NON-uniform weights, total 0-12. See `policies/02-scoring.md` and the `scoring_weights` slot.

scale_and_complexity.description: Portfolio, units, team, offices or network.

centralisation.description: Central processes and services, distinct roles.

evidence_of_system.description: A named incumbent system or a fragmented stack, never assumed.

pilotability.description: Heaviest weight: an isolable unit, a sponsor, an actual user, data.

signal.description: The specific fact that justifies contacting this account. Without it, no outreach.

type.$comment: Open string. Values are validated against the workspace's market configuration in `references/markets/`, which instantiates the `signal_types` slot. Signal types are market-specific and are the most expensive part of the configuration to regenerate.

angle_id.description: The message framing selected for this account, taken from the closed set of angles.
angle_id.$comment: Open string. Values are validated against the workspace's market configuration in `references/markets/`, which instantiates the `angle_set` slot. The set is closed per market: four angles over 26 accounts still allow learning, 26 angles allow none.

is_warm_relationship.description: If true, outbound and enrichment are forbidden (doctrine D4, the zero rule).

touch_count_email.description: Email touches already spent on this account.
touch_count_email.$comment: The effective limit is the `touch_cap_per_account` configuration slot (reference default: 2). The schema bound is 3, the highest value that slot may take. The cap is hard: doctrine D2 forbids a third touch, it does not discourage it.

reactivation_date.description: Populated only on an explicit dated deferral from the prospect.

exclusion_reason.$comment: Instantiates the `exclusion_rules` slot. The five categories are permanent: an excluded account leaves the queue, it does not wait in it.

evidence_ref.description: Email thread, file or URL that proves the current state.

contradictions.description: Conflicts between sources, to be flagged and not resolved. Example: a registry showing declared revenue incompatible with the declared portfolio.

priority_band.description: Reference bands: 9-12 A, 7-8 B, 5-6 C, below 5 not now. Further-research threshold: score 7 or above.
priority_band.$comment: Thresholds come from the `priority_bands` and `further_research_threshold` slots.

scan_json.description: Raw output of the site scan: scale, offices, team, software, public emails, signals, proof (URL). Source of the score points, kept for audit.

domain_alive.description: Mandatory check before any enrichment. In the reference sample 20% of domains were dead.
